name: Douglas DC-3
note: yawed ~25 deg in its file but in flying attitude (the fuselage's long axis within 1 deg of level): align 'pca' - NOT 'wing': the DC-3's swept LE and the outer panels' dihedral tilt the wing's chord axis 11.3 deg (aft is higher), which pitched the model nose-up; a twin with no nose engine: every station aft of the FUSELAGE'S NOSE TIP ('datum': 'nose') and every height above the centre of its deepest section ('level': 'body'), on both sides - the nacelles are parts measured against the body (the props' plane as a datum mixed the nacelle's length into every body station); the nacelles (Circle20, Circle21) have no role of the tool's - read by hand in step 3
